= callout-prefixes(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:icons: font

== Name
callout-prefixes - block comment prefixes

== Synopsis

[source,ruby,line-comment=%]
----
C01 custom % <1>
C02 other // <1>
C03 adjacent %<1>
C04 double space %  <1>
C05 repeated %% <1>
C06 escaped % \<1>
C07 adjacent markers % <1><2>
C08 nontrailing % <1> % <2>
C09 bare marker <1>
C10 trailing text % <1> tail
----
<1> First.
<2> Second.

[source,ruby,line-comment=]
----
C11 empty // <1>
C12 empty -- <1>
C13 empty # <1>
C14 empty ;; <1>
C15 empty XML <!--1-->
----
<1> Empty disables prefix removal.

[source,ruby,line-comment=""]
----
C16 quoted empty // <1>
----
<1> Quoted empty prefix.

[source,ruby,line-comment="※"]
----
C17 café ※ <1>
C18 unrelated % <1>
----
<1> Unicode prefix.

[source,ruby,line-comment="// "]
----
C19 authored space // <1>
C20 optional extra space //  <1>
C21 missing authored space //<1>
----
<1> Prefix with trailing space.

[line-comment="a.*"]
----
C22 literal pattern a.* <1>
C23 not a pattern abc <1>
----
<1> Regex characters are literal.

[line-comment=%]
....
C24 literal % <1>
....
<1> Literal block.

[literal,line-comment=%]
C25 literal paragraph % <1>

<1> Literal paragraph.

//-

[source,ruby,line-comment=%]
C26 source paragraph % <1>

<1> Source paragraph.

[line-comment=%]
```ruby
C27 fenced % <1>
```
<1> Fenced source.

[source,ruby]
----
C28 restored // <1>
C29 default XML // <!--1-->
C30 default XML <!--1-->
----
<1> Default behavior returns.

:line-comment: %

[source,ruby]
----
C31 document attribute % <1>
C32 document attribute // <1>
----
<1> Only block attributes select the prefix.

:line-comment!:
:icons!:

[source,ruby,line-comment=%]
----
C33 no icons % <1>
----
<1> PDF prefix removal does not depend on icons.

[source,ruby,line-comment]
----
C34 positional attribute // <1>
----
<1> A positional word does not set the prefix.

[source,ruby,line-comment=%]
----
C35 tab %	<1>
C36 nonbreaking space % <1>
----
<1> Only an ASCII space can follow the prefix.

[source%autofit,ruby,linenums,start=20,highlight=21,line-comment=%]
----
C37 fitted % <1>
C38 numbered % <1>
----
<1> Line options and fitted code keep the same prefix policy.
